en: Will she fly, or will she fall?!
Will they fly, or will they fall?!
Will he fly, or will he fall!?
We'll find out soon-- BUT~!
The Gym Battle alone is not the only trial that yet awaits our eager hero!
Master~ Would you do the honors?
RADOMUS: Naturally. Allow me to explain--
GARDEVOIR: As you may have heard, Master is a world-renowned master of chess~
RADOMUS: Was I not going to do the honor?
GARDEVOIR: Ahaha~ Sorry, Master, the floor is yours!
RADOMUS: And speaking of the floor, you will notice that it is arranged like a chess board.
Now, of course, it would be all too unfair for me to ask you to face off against me in such a game.
Fear not; I will not be so unscrupulous.
Here, instead, is your task:
Obeying the normal rules of each chess piece, arrange your pieces in such a way that I am placed in checkmate.
There are also new restrictions on each of us:
I may not move my pieces.
However, you may not capture them.
All pieces still are considered to attack their normal territory.
In other words, you have an infinite number of turns to find a solution of checkmate, with my pieces locked into their present positions.
When you think you have found a solution, please access the door below me to check.
Finally, if you have any questions regarding the normal rules of pieces or play, my butler will address them in the room on the left.
Observe how the sole warrior on the board, her Lady, may pose a fine fight yet!
The Queen is the strongest piece-- never forget!
Onwards, young Queen.
Onwards, young Majesty.
Onwards, young King.
RADOMUS: Are you quite through? Shall we check the board?
RADOMUS: Very well.
Oh-ho. You are very close! Perhaps too close.
In fact, with as close as your Rook is, the Black King can merely capture it to escape from check.
RADOMUS: Indeed, that would be checkmate. Very good!
However!
There is one more trial for this room.
In a normal chess game, one need only corner the King for the game to be over.
Alas, this is not a normal chess game.
Our King will fight back!
RADOMUS: I'll leave you to that one.
I'll be waiting at the end. See you soon, \PN.
RADOMUS: Ah, it looks like you've made an illegal move.
By bringing your King so close to mine, you've placed yourself into check.
Careful now.
RADOMUS: Hm... Seems you're not quite there yet.
You're going to need to have both of your pieces doing work for this one.
However! There is one more trial for this room.

RADOMUS: You have as much time as you need.
AME: Ah, you're challenging Radomus.
Radomus is a Doubles Leader whose strategy focuses around Trick Room.
His team is bulky and hits hard, and if he sets up, then it's going to be rough going.
But if you can stop him from using Trick Room, then he might as well be a sitting duck.
Keep in mind the order your party is in can also affect battles in his arena!
Your last Pokémon will always be a Queen, and your leads will always be Pawns.
The rest depend on their stats, so plan carefully about who you want to take which role, since each one gets different effects!
Remember, Knights are the best pieces to deal with a rogue Queen!

Blood for blood, as always.
The city bleeds, and so to staunch the wound, we cut into the wildlife.
So Reborn never changes...
Maybe that man from Team Meteor was onto something.
It's a pity that Reborn has had to cut into the trees here to support the city's reconstruction, but I'm sure it's for the best.
Though honestly, you'd think they'd have had enough trees from the ones that grew all over the city.
Many of those were transplanted into the city's various parks, but I suppose even that wasn't enough.
Did you need anything? If not, could you let us be?
Beat it kid, we're working here.
We've got a lot of wood to process here; shove off.
SANDY: There you are!
I got nervous when I saw there were so many of them, but we should be able to handle this... Right?
C'mon, deep breath... I can do this.
This is for the Pokémon...
Let's go!
SANDY: Excuse me!
On behalf of all the Pokémon living in this forest...
I'll punish you!
Uhh...
So, my shift still doesn't end for another couple hours...
SANDY: Yes! That one's for the future!
Now go home and rethink your destructive ways!
HARD HAT: That's them; those are the ones causing a disturbance.
ADRIENN: I... \PN?
SANDY: Um.... Mx. Flores?
Ah, this is lucky!
I just need a moment of your time to talk about the deforestation of Malchous and other environmental concerns following the city's restoration.
ADRIENN: And you must be... the Reserve Ground Leader, Sandy.
I heard that you were like this.
SANDY: That's right, but what's important is that you take action to ensure the safety of our world.
I've submitted several petitions in due process asking for a reformation of several policies to better the--
ADRIENN: Yes, yes-- I've read them.
I understand your concerns, but in each case, it's not as simple as just immediately throwing people at the issue.
We'll keep working towards a satisfactory solution, but in the meantime...
Could I ask you to not accost the city workers?
They're just working towards a wage; it's not their decision how much of Malchous is used.
And for the record, I understand that most of these trees were generated by the PULSE incident in this area.
Our priority has always been to use up that artificially augmented plant life for its resources before cutting into the natural environment.
And in any case, the simple fact is that large construction projects will require a lot of wood.
If you understand, then I'll ask for your patience in resolving these matters properly.
Men, why don't you go ahead and take a break?
Keep an eye on her for me, please.
SANDY: Well... Okay.
Maybe that was a little hasty, but...
I'm gonna mark that down as a partial success!
Now, what to do next...
Mm... I know!
Azurine Lake has really cleared up ever since the Water Treatment Center came back online...
But the truth is, some of the chemicals used to "clean" it are actually still harmful to the Pokémon!
Thanks to an anonymous source, I was able to acquire an alternate filter to apply to the main head of the Treatment Center...
I think it will go a long way to protecting the Pokémon of the lake!
Meet me at the central part of the Water Treatment Center, in the Opal Grid!
We'll protect the lake together!
CORIN-ROUGE: A-ha!
My dashing dame!
My glorious goddess!
You've found me at last!
Or have you?
As if the real Corin-Rouge would be caught so easily!
Ah, ah, but strength alone is not enough to win~
Aha~ As expected from a damsel as radiant as yourself!
But I am a man of honor, and I shall never break a promise to a lady.
As such, I'll generously give you a hint about the whereabouts of the real Corin-Rouge...
Hm, not bad.
As promised, I'll give you a hint about the whereabouts of the real Corin-Rouge...
Find him buried in a pocket of peonies!
Hello there!
I'm researching the geological history of the Reborn Region!
Interested?
Wonderful! Let's start with this. Did you know that long ago, Ametrine Mountain used to be a volcano?
But that's not all! Pyrous Mountain in Apophyll used to be as frigid as Ametrine now is!
Legends from an old civilization say that the day their civilization ended was the day that Giratina came to Reborn.
They say the dragon was in a frenzy, and all around it bizarre things would happen.
Objects would disappear, lands would be spun upside down, and whole towns were transported across the region in the blink of an eye.
According to the stories, by the time the dimensional warrior finally settled in the south-east of the region, its chaos had already sealed the fate of Reborn.
Ametrine froze, and every speck of magma turned into crystal clear ice water.
Pyrous erupted all at once, a volley of smoke and snow upheaved from its peak.
The lava bled down the slope, burning away what traces of lives had been there in what is now Apophyll.
And in the months to follow, the rising temperatures thawed the snow, which formed what is now Azurine Lake,
Burying their old city beneath it.
I hear some divers can still find artifacts from those days down there!
As for Giratina...
I wonder what could have happened to it? The records about it ended there.
Ohmigod, it's YOU!
I've seen you on TV-- you know, Gossip Gardevoir's show? Introduce me sometime!
But she's showed us all about how you've been fighting Team Meteor and saving Reborn!
That's SO cool!
Oh my god, can I do something to help you?
Anything? Wait! I know!
I have a Sticker! It's not much!
In fact I feel like a little kid saying that... But surely it can be of some small use, right?
\PN obtained a Department Store Sticker!
Think of me whenever you use it!
Oh, and you should take this, too!
Wait, what do you mean you don't have a Department Store Card!?
You've been kicking ass in Reborn for HOW long and you haven't gotten one yet?
You just gotta fix that!
And then! Aaah!
I can be your first...
...Uh, first Sticker-giver! That's what I meant!
Don't read too far into it!
Think of me whenever you go to that store!
I moved out to Apophyll when things started getting rough, and I was excited to come back now that they're better.
But somehow, I miss it out there?
Maybe I'll go back-- of my own free will this time.
Kiki would be proud if I decided to do that, right?
I wish I could get the ring back, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
and of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
Ugggh, what am I going to do?
My relationship is over.
No,
My life is over.
I'm going to die of embarrassment.
Sorry, I'll start from the beginning.
My fiancee and I had a little... misunderstanding?
I thought they were cheating on me, so when I got mad, I flung my engagement ring out into the lake.
The truth was cleared up later, and everything's okay with us now,
But I haven't told them that I lost the ring yet.
I've never felt regret like this...
I wish I could fix it, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
And of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
Hey, wait...
That ring you've got there... There's no way...
Did you really find it!?
You are a true savior!
To be honest, I chanced across something interesting, and I was considering doing something drastic in order to pay for a custom replacement.
But since you found it, why don't you take this instead?
I don't really know what that's about either, but at least I won't have to be responsible for it now.
Hopefully you can find a use for it!
Thank you for finding my ring!
Oh, and as for that other thing, could you not mention that to anyone?

Day unknown.
I've been unsuccessful thus far in navigating this hellish cave.
Despite the rails--
Despite the stone markings I've tried to leave--
Despite carefully recording my passages through this place--
I'm baffled.
Utterly and completely...
I felt relocating here would be a leap towards progress to finding my way home.
Instead I feel I've entrenched myself in the prison of this place.
Progress has once again teased me with her coy seduction.
In my continual stumbling through the labyrinth, I found nestled into the wall, a door imprinted upon the stone in a glowing light.
Beyond its threshold, a world of glittering, static blue and stars.
I do not know what awaits me in the world.
I do know that I am weak.
I am thin, and exhausted-- physically, mentally, emotionally.
I cannot refuse the chance that this will lead me to safety.
But there is no promise in those jilted lands, and I do not expect to return.
If anyone finds this--
Please apologize to my little girl, Snow, for me.
And her gift-- I would ask someone look after the Pokémon.
I may disappear into this strange dimension, but it need not share my fate.
This is Captain Florence, signing out.
Good night.

Welcome to the South Obsidia Low Income Community Estate-- or SOLICE for short.
Here we offer high-quality but low-cost studio and one-bedroom rental spaces in return for a weekly volunteer schedule.
Everyone deserves SOLICE in their time of need, and now they can have it in return for volunteer time in helping either us or the community.
I beg your pardon though, you seem familiar.
Oh! You're the person who laid down the funding to finish this place, aren't you?
It's an honor to meet you!
I'll tell you what, when the folks at the Grand Hall told me one person had donated the entire rest of our goal's cost, I was pretty floored.
But this has been a passion project for me for years, you know?
I just never thought it would be possible!
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
